# Where to Watch Heidi Rescue of the Lynx


by Angel | September 17, 2026


In the Swiss Alps, spirited young Heidi discovers an injured lynx cub and takes it under her care. But when she learns that a greedy industrialist plans to build a sawmill that could destroy the Alpine home she loves, Heidi sets out to protect both the cub and the mountains.


Joined by Peter and Joseph, Heidi faces a new adventure filled with friendship, courage, and a wild animal that needs her help.


[Stream Heidi Rescue of the Lynx now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/heidi-rescue-of-the-lynx)


### **A New Adventure for a Beloved Heroine**


Heidi has been capturing imaginations for generations, and this animated adventure introduces the beloved heroine to a new generation.


This time, Heidi’s connection to the natural world begins with an unexpected discovery: an injured lynx cub in need of help. Determined to return the cub to the wild, she sets out with Peter and Joseph on a journey through the Swiss Alps.


But their mission soon becomes bigger than one animal.


### **Protecting the Swiss Alps**


Heidi’s home is more than a beautiful backdrop. The mountains are an important part of the story—and they’re threatened by a plan to build a sawmill that could cause lasting damage to the landscape.


Heidi and her friends must find a way to protect the place they love while working to get the young lynx safely back into the wild.


The story gives its young heroine a meaningful challenge without losing the sense of adventure and wonder that makes Heidi such a beloved character.


### **Bringing the Alps to Life**


The Swiss Alps provide a spectacular setting for Heidi’s adventure, from snow-capped peaks to the wild landscapes surrounding her home.


The animation was a standout for many Angel Guild members. One member called it “beautiful animation of the Swiss Alps,” while another praised the “gorgeous” rendering and visuals and described the characters as adorable.


The scenery isn’t simply there to look beautiful. It gives the story its sense of place and helps create the feeling of stepping into Heidi’s world.


### **A Family Adventure With Heart**


*Heidi Rescue of the Lynx* is built for families who enjoy stories filled with adventure, beautiful scenery, and characters worth rooting for.


The film has also connected with viewers across generations. One Rotten Tomatoes reviewer shared that she and her six-year-old daughter were both amazed by the film, praising its animation, story, and vivid characters.


Angel Guild members echoed that enthusiasm, calling it a wonderful story with fantastic graphics and a film kids would enjoy.


### **Watch** ***Heidi Rescue of the Lynx*** **on Angel**


From a rescued lynx cub to a threatened Alpine landscape, *Heidi Rescue of the Lynx* gives a beloved character a new adventure to share with the whole family.
